scope: offline re-audit of the v11 Modal one-time-token remediation and scientific admissibility of one replacement micro-validation invocation

authorization_remediation.mechanism: modal.Secret.from_dict supplies SLOFORGE_MODAL_PREFLIGHT_TOKEN only as a runtime function secret
authorization_remediation.remote_binding: The remote module reads the injected environment value and requires authorization.preflight_token_sha256 to equal SHA-256(token); configuration SHA, one A100 identity, and exactly 525 GPU-seconds remain independently bound.
evidence: gpu_image is constructed before the Secret and no image construction, env, local-file, or local-directory call receives the token
the Secret object is attached exactly once through secrets=[_launch_token_secret] to the one-A100 function
the raw token is absent from config, authorization payload, completion, result publication, logging and immutable result writers; authorization carries only its SHA-256
the code uses neither Secret.from_name nor a deployed/named secret API
the function remains A100-80GB:1, timeout 525, retries 0, max_containers 1, buffer_containers 0 and single-use
authorization_remediation.scope_note: This proves that SLOForge does not bake or persist the raw token and uses Modal's anonymous runtime-secret attachment. It does not make claims about provider-internal encrypted control-plane retention beyond that API contract.

replacement_micro.rationale: The first invocation failed before model loading, live state construction, export/import, continuation, instrumentation, or any measured outcome. It therefore supplies no performance or correctness observation to select on and is not a scientific repetition. A single fresh replacement with the unchanged seed and workload is not cherry-picking.
required_freshness: new unique attempt ID and immutable remote result prefix
new config bound to the post-failure ledger and resealed offline manifest
new one-GPU 525-second reservation created atomically immediately before launch
no automatic retry and no reuse or deletion of the failed attempt artifacts
unchanged_parameters: 16,384 shared tokens, fanout 8, 256 private tokens, 1,152 pages and 1,056,964,608 bytes
8 continuation tokens per branch and 8/8 independent recomputation
canonical StatePassRecord measurement and strict amplification go/no-go

requirements: reseal the offline manifest with the current Modal source, structural test, this Agent08b review, and the post-remediation make-check evidence
generate a fresh config that binds the resealed manifest and current pre-reservation ledger hash
validate the fresh config locally before creating the replacement reservation

full_make_check.rust: format, clippy, workspace tests and doc tests PASS
full_make_check.ui: typecheck, lint, 37 tests and build PASS

decision: PASS: the runtime Secret remediation correctly carries the one-time authorization token without image baking or application-level persistence. Exactly one scientifically fresh replacement micro is acceptable after resealing and atomic budget reservation.
